# Convert date column to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create additional features for analysis
df['total_goals'] = df['number of goals team1'] + df['number of goals team2']
df['goal_difference'] = abs(df['number of goals team1'] - df['number of goals team2'])
df['high_scoring'] = df['total_goals'] >= 3

# Convert possession percentages to numeric (remove % and convert)
df['possession_team1_pct'] = df['possession team1'].str.replace('%', '').astype(float)
df['possession_team2_pct'] = df['possession team2'].str.replace('%', '').astype(float)

# Create match outcome column
def get_match_outcome(row):
    if row['number of goals team1'] > row['number of goals team2']:
        return f"{row['team1']} wins"
    elif row['number of goals team1'] < row['number of goals team2']:
        return f"{row['team2']} wins"
    else:
        return "Draw"

df['match_outcome'] = df.apply(get_match_outcome, axis=1)

# Extract tournament stage
df['tournament_stage'] = df['category']

print(df)

# =====================================
# CANVAS 1 : GOALS & POSSESSION ANALYSIS
# =====================================

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 12))
fig.suptitle(
    'Goals and Possession Analysis',
    fontsize=20,
    fontweight='bold'
)

# -------------------------------------
# 1. Distribution of Total Goals
# -------------------------------------
sns.histplot(
    data=df,
    x='total_goals',
    bins=range(0, df['total_goals'].max()+2),
    kde=True,
    color='royalblue',
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.75,
    ax=axes[0,0]
)

axes[0,0].set_title('Distribution of Total Goals per Match',
                    fontsize=13,
                    fontweight='bold')
axes[0,0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# -------------------------------------
# 2. Goals by Tournament Stage
# -------------------------------------
sns.boxplot(
    data=df,
    x='tournament_stage',
    y='total_goals',
    palette='Blues',
    ax=axes[0,1]
)

axes[0,1].set_title('Goals Distribution by Tournament Stage',
                    fontsize=13,
                    fontweight='bold')

axes[0,1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[0,1].grid(alpha=0.3)

# -------------------------------------
# 3. Goal Difference Distribution
# -------------------------------------
goal_diff_counts = df['goal_difference'].value_counts().sort_index()

sns.barplot(
    x=goal_diff_counts.index,
    y=goal_diff_counts.values,
    palette='crest',
    ax=axes[1,0]
)

axes[1,0].set_title('Match Goal Difference Distribution',
                    fontsize=13,
                    fontweight='bold')

axes[1,0].set_xlabel('Goal Difference')
axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Number of Matches')
axes[1,0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# -------------------------------------
# 4. Possession vs Goals
# -------------------------------------
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='possession_team1_pct',
    y='number of goals team1',
    color='darkorange',
    s=90,
    alpha=0.75,
    edgecolor='black',
    ax=axes[1,1]
)

sns.regplot(
    data=df,
    x='possession_team1_pct',
    y='number of goals team1',
    scatter=False,
    color='red',
    ax=axes[1,1]
)

axes[1,1].set_title('Possession vs Goals Scored (Team 1)',
                    fontsize=13,
                    fontweight='bold')

axes[1,1].grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(18, 12))
fig.suptitle(
    'Discipline and Match Intensity Analysis',
    fontsize=20,
    fontweight='bold'
)

# -------------------------------------
# 1. Shooting Accuracy Distribution
# -------------------------------------
df['shooting_accuracy_team1'] = (
    df['on target attempts team1']
    / df['total attempts team1'] * 100
).fillna(0)

sns.histplot(
    data=df,
    x='shooting_accuracy_team1',
    bins=20,
    kde=True,
    color='mediumpurple',
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.75,
    ax=axes[0,0]
)

axes[0,0].set_title(
    'Shooting Accuracy Distribution (Team 1)',
    fontsize=13,
    fontweight='bold'
)
axes[0,0].set_xlabel('Shooting Accuracy (%)')
axes[0,0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# -------------------------------------
# 2. Disciplinary Actions Distribution
# -------------------------------------
disciplinary_data = pd.DataFrame({
    'Yellow Cards': df['yellow cards team1'] + df['yellow cards team2'],
    'Red Cards': df['red cards team1'] + df['red cards team2'],
    'Fouls': df['fouls against team1'] + df['fouls against team2']
})

sns.boxplot(
    data=disciplinary_data,
    palette='Set3',
    ax=axes[0,1]
)

axes[0,1].set_title(
    'Disciplinary Actions Distribution',
    fontsize=13,
    fontweight='bold'
)
axes[0,1].grid(alpha=0.3)

# -------------------------------------
# 3. Fouls vs Yellow Cards
# -------------------------------------
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='fouls against team1',
    y='yellow cards team1',
    color='crimson',
    s=90,
    alpha=0.75,
    edgecolor='black',
    ax=axes[1,0]
)

sns.regplot(
    data=df,
    x='fouls against team1',
    y='yellow cards team1',
    scatter=False,
    color='black',
    ax=axes[1,0]
)

axes[1,0].set_title(
    'Fouls vs Yellow Cards (Team 1)',
    fontsize=13,
    fontweight='bold'
)
axes[1,0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# -------------------------------------
# 4. High Scoring Matches by Stage
# -------------------------------------
sns.countplot(
    data=df,
    x='tournament_stage',
    hue='high_scoring',
    palette='coolwarm',
    ax=axes[1,1]
)

axes[1,1].set_title(
    'High Scoring Matches by Tournament Stage',
    fontsize=13,
    fontweight='bold'
)

axes[1,1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[1,1].legend(title='3+ Goals Match')
axes[1,1].grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# =====================================
# ADVANCED PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS
# =====================================

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(20, 14))

fig.suptitle(
    'Advanced Team Performance Analysis',
    fontsize=20,
    fontweight='bold'
)

# =====================================
# 1. PERFORMANCE METRICS CORRELATION
# =====================================

performance_metrics = [
    'total attempts team1',
    'on target attempts team1',
    'possession_team1_pct',
    'passes completed team1',
    'crosses completed team1',
    'number of goals team1',
    'assists team1',
    'goal inside the penalty area team1'
]

correlation_matrix = df[performance_metrics].corr()

sns.heatmap(
    correlation_matrix,
    annot=True,
    cmap='RdYlBu_r',
    center=0,
    square=True,
    linewidths=0.5,
    fmt='.2f',
    ax=axes[0,0]
)

axes[0,0].set_title(
    'Performance Metrics Correlation Matrix',
    fontsize=13,
    fontweight='bold'
)

# =====================================
# 2. GOAL EFFICIENCY ANALYSIS
# =====================================

df['goal_efficiency_team1'] = (
    df['number of goals team1']
    / df['total attempts team1'] * 100
).fillna(0)

sns.boxplot(
    data=df,
    x='tournament_stage',
    y='goal_efficiency_team1',
    palette='YlOrRd',
    ax=axes[0,1]
)

axes[0,1].set_title(
    'Goal Efficiency by Tournament Stage',
    fontsize=13,
    fontweight='bold'
)

axes[0,1].set_xlabel('Tournament Stage')
axes[0,1].set_ylabel('Goal Efficiency (%)')
axes[0,1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[0,1].grid(alpha=0.3)

# =====================================
# 3. PASS ACCURACY VS POSSESSION
# =====================================

df['pass_accuracy_team1'] = (
    df['passes completed team1']
    / df['passes team1'] * 100
).fillna(0)

sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='pass_accuracy_team1',
    y='possession_team1_pct',
    color='forestgreen',
    s=90,
    alpha=0.75,
    edgecolor='black',
    ax=axes[1,0]
)

sns.regplot(
    data=df,
    x='pass_accuracy_team1',
    y='possession_team1_pct',
    scatter=False,
    color='darkgreen',
    ax=axes[1,0]
)

axes[1,0].set_title(
    'Pass Accuracy vs Possession',
    fontsize=13,
    fontweight='bold'
)

axes[1,0].set_xlabel('Pass Accuracy (%)')
axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Possession (%)')
axes[1,0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# =====================================
# 4. DEFENSIVE PRESSURE ANALYSIS
# =====================================

sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='defensive pressures applied team1',
    y='forced turnovers team1',
    color='crimson',
    s=90,
    alpha=0.75,
    edgecolor='black',
    ax=axes[1,1]
)

sns.regplot(
    data=df,
    x='defensive pressures applied team1',
    y='forced turnovers team1',
    scatter=False,

)

axes[1,1].set_title(

axes[1,1].set_xlabel('Defensive Pressures Applied')
axes[1,1].set_ylabel('Forced Turnovers')
axes[1,1].grid(alpha=0.3)

# =====================================
# TEAM PERFORMANCE DASHBOARD
# =====================================

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(20, 14))

fig.suptitle(
    'FIFA World Cup 2022 - Team Performance Dashboard',
    fontsize=20,
    fontweight='bold'
)

# =====================================
# 1. TOP 10 TEAMS BY POINTS
# =====================================

top_teams = team_df.head(10)

sns.barplot(
    data=top_teams,
    x='Points',
    y='Team',
    palette='viridis',
    ax=axes[0,0]
)

axes[0,0].set_title(
    'Top 10 Teams by Points',
    fontsize=14,
    fontweight='bold'
)

for i, value in enumerate(top_teams['Points']):
    axes[0,0].text(
        value + 0.2,
        i,
        str(value),
        va='center',
        fontweight='bold'
    )

axes[0,0].grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# =====================================
# 2. GOALS SCORED VS GOALS CONCEDED
# =====================================

sns.scatterplot(
    data=team_df,
    x='Goals Conceded',
    y='Goals Scored',
    size='Matches Played',
    hue='Points',
    palette='viridis',
    sizes=(50, 500),
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    ax=axes[0,1]
)

sns.regplot(
    data=team_df,
    x='Goals Conceded',
    y='Goals Scored',
    scatter=False,
    color='red',
    ax=axes[0,1]
)

axes[0,1].set_title(
    'Goals Scored vs Goals Conceded',
    fontsize=14,
    fontweight='bold'
)

axes[0,1].grid(alpha=0.3)

# =====================================
# 3. WIN RATE DISTRIBUTION
# =====================================

sns.histplot(
    data=team_df,
    x='Win Rate (%)',
    bins=12,
    kde=True,
    color='forestgreen',
    edgecolor='black',
    alpha=0.75,
    ax=axes[1,0]
)

mean_win_rate = team_df['Win Rate (%)'].mean()

axes[1,0].axvline(
    mean_win_rate,
    color='red',
    linestyle='--',
    linewidth=2,
    label=f'Mean = {mean_win_rate:.1f}%'
)

axes[1,0].legend()

axes[1,0].set_title(
    'Distribution of Team Win Rates',
    fontsize=14,
    fontweight='bold'
)

axes[1,0].set_xlabel('Win Rate (%)')
axes[1,0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[1,0].grid(alpha=0.3)

# =====================================
# 4. GOAL DIFFERENCE VS POINTS
# =====================================

sns.scatterplot(
    data=team_df,
    x='Goal Difference',
    y='Points',
    size='Matches Played',
    hue='Win Rate (%)',
    palette='plasma',
    sizes=(50, 500),
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    ax=axes[1,1]
)

sns.regplot(
    data=team_df,
    x='Goal Difference',
    y='Points',
    scatter=False,
    color='black',
    ax=axes[1,1]
)

# Label Top 5 Teams
for _, row in team_df.head(5).iterrows():
    axes[1,1].annotate(
        row['Team'],
        (row['Goal Difference'], row['Points']),
        xytext=(5, 5),
        textcoords='offset points',
        fontsize=9,
        fontweight='bold'
    )

axes[1,1].set_title(
    'Goal Difference vs Points',
    fontsize=14,
    fontweight='bold'
)

axes[1,1].grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.97])
plt.show()

# FIFA WORLD CUP 2022 - TOURNAMENT SUMMARY

print("\nFIFA WORLD CUP 2022 - STATISTICAL SUMMARY REPORT")

# TOURNAMENT OVERVIEW

print("\nTOURNAMENT OVERVIEW")

print(f"Total Matches Analyzed              : {len(df)}")
print(f"Total Goals Scored                  : {df['total_goals'].sum()}")
print(f"Average Goals per Match             : {df['total_goals'].mean():.2f}")
print(f"Highest Scoring Match               : {df['total_goals'].max()} Goals")
print(f"Matches with 3+ Goals               : {(df['total_goals'] >= 3).sum()}")
print(f"Percentage of High-Scoring Matches  : {(df['total_goals'] >= 3).mean()*100:.1f}%")
print(f"Most Common Goal Difference         : {df['goal_difference'].mode()[0]}")

# POSSESSION ANALYSIS

print("\nPOSSESSION INSIGHTS")

print(f"Average Possession Difference       : {abs(df['possession_difference']).mean():.2f}%")

possession_corr = df[
    ['possession_team1_pct', 'number of goals team1']
].corr().iloc[0, 1]

print(f"Possession–Goals Correlation        : {possession_corr:.3f}")

# SHOOTING ANALYSIS

print("\nSHOOTING PERFORMANCE")

print(f"Average Shooting Accuracy           : {df['shooting_accuracy_team1'].mean():.2f}%")

shots_goals_corr = df[
    ['total attempts team1', 'number of goals team1']
].corr().iloc[0, 1]

print(f"Shots–Goals Correlation             : {shots_goals_corr:.3f}")

# DISCIPLINARY ANALYSIS

print("\nDISCIPLINARY INSIGHTS")

print(f"Average Yellow Cards/Match          : {(df['yellow cards team1'] + df['yellow cards team2']).mean():.2f}")
print(f"Average Red Cards/Match             : {(df['red cards team1'] + df['red cards team2']).mean():.2f}")
print(f"Average Fouls/Match                 : {(df['fouls against team1'] + df['fouls against team2']).mean():.2f}")

# TOURNAMENT STRUCTURE

print("\nTOURNAMENT STRUCTURE")

stage_summary = (
    df['tournament_stage']
    .value_counts()
    .reset_index()
)

for _, row in stage_summary.iterrows():
    print(f"{row['tournament_stage']:<25} : {row['count']} Matches")

# KEY TAKEAWAYS

print("\nKEY TAKEAWAYS")

print(f"• The tournament produced an average of {df['total_goals'].mean():.2f} goals per match.")
print(f"• {(df['total_goals'] >= 3).mean()*100:.1f}% of matches were classified as high-scoring (3+ goals).")
print(f"• The correlation between possession and goals was {possession_corr:.3f}.")
print(f"• The correlation between total attempts and goals scored was {shots_goals_corr:.3f}.")
print(f"• Teams received an average of {(df['yellow cards team1'] + df['yellow cards team2']).mean():.2f} yellow cards per match.")

print("\nEND OF REPORT")
